subpages.title: Alfafonet Complete Connectivity Solutions
subpages.text: Alfafonet Company Alfafonet is a manufacturer of fiber optic connectivity products used in data communications and telecommunication networks. It was established in 2011 by a team that leads the sector with its experience of 20 years in order to develop and market innovative, ergonomic, economic and functional products. Alfafonet has used its expertise to build a comprehensive range of high quality network communications products which includes patch cords, pigtails (multimode and singlemode), patch panels, wall-mount and splice boxes (unloaded and customised), ODF cabinets and accessories,Telecom field cabinets(unloaded and fully integrated) and a full range of accessories. It offers a broad range of products directly and through distributors, installers and OEM partners. Customer Service Alfafonets growth has been founded on quality products, rapid response and excellent Customer Service. Quality All products are manufactured in ISO 9001:2015 certified facilities and conform to applicable international standards. Alfafonet is dedicated to value and continuous improvement of all its products and services. Environmental Management System Alfafonet operates an environmental management system which complies with requirements of ISO 14001:2015 Global Logistics With headquarters in Istanbul (TR), Alfafonet has manufacturing activities in Eskiþehir (TR). The Company has both volume and quick response manufacturing capabilities and is able to support the global logistics requirements of its customers. Alfafonet provides customised and customer branded products for OEM customers. Our Integrated Management System Policy Please click for IMS Policy.
